summary: SFL Corp Ltd. filed a Form 6-K announcing a tap issue of $75 million of its existing senior unsecured sustainability-linked bonds due 2030, priced at 103.5% of par, increasing total outstanding to $225 million. The transaction is a routine debt issuance, not a special situation. Net proceeds will be used for general corporate purposes. The new bonds trade under a separate ISIN until merged. Joint bookrunners are Danske Bank and Arctic Securities. This is an ordinary capital markets activity, not a restructuring, acquisition, or other special situation.
